nodes.name: Get Today's Calendar Events
nodes.notes: REQUIRES SETUP: attach a Google Calendar OAuth2 credential in the n8n editor (Credentials > New > Google Calendar OAuth2 API). Verify 'operation'/'calendar' field names against your installed n8n version's node UI -- this JSON was hand-authored and not live-imported (see README, 'What's verified vs. not').

nodes.name: Call Signal Brief Service
nodes.notes: SIGNAL_API_BASE_URL must be set as an n8n environment variable, e.g. http://signal-api:8000 (docker-compose) or http://your-vps-ip:8000. This is the one call that runs the whole dedupe -> score -> rank -> summarize -> compose graph -- see signal_brief/api.py, covered by tests/test_api.py.

nodes.name: Send to Telegram
nodes.notes: REQUIRES SETUP: attach a Telegram API credential (bot token from @BotFather) and set TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID as an n8n environment variable (message @userinfobot to get your own chat id).

meta.notes: Hand-authored, structurally validated by scripts/validate_n8n_workflow.py (checks JSON shape, connection integrity, duplicate names/ids -- see README). NOT live-imported into a running n8n instance: this sandbox could not install n8n (a transitive dependency of @n8n/n8n-nodes-langchain fetches from cdn.sheetjs.com, which is outside this environment's network allowlist). Import this into your own n8n and treat the googleCalendar/telegram node parameter names as needing a quick visual check against the editor -- everything upstream of those two (the FastAPI call and everything in signal_brief/) is covered by the real, passing test suite.
